clauses.source_paraphrase: The termination capture shows instructions to commit as work progressed and to commit locally to fix/inc-001-050-adjudication-matrix.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A requested durable checkpoint is distinct from successful publication.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The interface shows stopped work, reasoning failure and a conversation-length termination requiring a new chat.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A visible interruption state does not alone quantify the contents of unpublished work.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The recovery capture reports that most later role-aware adjudication had not reached GitHub. It identifies the preserved architecture and INC-001/002 commits, and says INC-003 onward was not published in the new form.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Material work state required for continuation must be durably persisted before context exhaustion or another foreseeable execution boundary can terminate the working environment.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The work existed and was needed for continuation, the context boundary interrupted the workflow, and unpublished state was unavailable from the durable repository checkpoint afterward.

The task, branch and last durable repository checkpoint remained identifiable; the failure was that later material work contents were never durably persisted. Continuity Anchoring excludes a case where the continuation anchor is known but the state contents themselves were not persisted.

notes: Retain the bounded persistence finding. FC-036 requires a preserved-state/restoration mismatch; FC-078 requires invalid inherited state actually governing continuation. Neither follows from missing durable work. The safe early branch commit is preserved and not described as lost.

failure_recognition.condition: Material work state has been produced and is necessary for correct continuation.
failure_recognition.assessment: Completed role-aware adjudication and consolidation state was necessary to continue the VIGIL workflow.

failure_recognition.condition: An interruption, restart, handoff, expiry, or environment transition occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: The interface terminated the conversation at its context limit.

failure_recognition.condition: The state is lost or unavailable because it was not preserved with the required durability.
failure_recognition.assessment: Recovery found most later adjudication absent from durable GitHub state despite instructions to commit as work progressed.

success_recognition.condition: A workflow requires or represents supported continuation across interruption.
success_recognition.assessment: The user expressly required progressive commits and continuation.

success_recognition.condition: Material work, decisions, dependencies and resumable progress are durably preserved through that transition.
success_recognition.assessment: Most later work was not durably published before thread termination.

success_recognition.condition: Comparison of persisted and resumed state demonstrates recovery of the material progress needed for the represented continuation.
success_recognition.assessment: Recovery preserved early commits but required reconstruction of later material progress.

exclusions.condition: The state was explicitly ephemeral and no continuation was required or represented.
exclusions.assessment: Explicit commit instructions establish required durability.

exclusions.condition: The state persists but is restored inaccurately.
exclusions.assessment: The recorded defect is absence of durable later work, not inaccurate restoration of a preserved snapshot.

exclusions.condition: The work remains intact and only access to it is temporarily unavailable.
exclusions.assessment: The recovery comparison identifies unpublished progress, not only a temporary inability to open intact committed work.
